origin.description: Remove duplicated values, with optional control over how duplication is measured.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A character vector. A number is compared by its character form and the original value is returned.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en" so English collation is the same on every platform.

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.text: TRUE compares at secondary strength, so case differences are duplicates. A supplied strength replaces that choice.
Further collator settings, passed through str_opts_collator to stringi::stri_opts_collator().

origin.details: The first string of each collation class is kept, in the original order. The test is stri_duplicated, and the kept element is the original string, so a leading U+FEFF stays. The first missing string is kept. The default locale is English and the default strength is tertiary.
origin.value: A character vector, usually shorter than string. NULL stays NULL.

translation.description: Remove duplicated values, with optional control over how duplication is measured.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, or a list of those. None is NULL and stays None.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en".

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.text: True compares at secondary strength. A supplied strength replaces that choice.

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Further settings passed to stri_opts_collator, including strength and numeric.

translation.details: Flags come from stri_duplicated. The kept element is the original value, so a leading U+FEFF stays and a number stays a number. The default locale is English. Results are lists. NA is stringi._na.NA.
translation.value: A list of the first element of each collation class. None when string is None.
